violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: QUESO AT 122F IN STEAM TABLE IN ONLINE ORDER SECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT FOODS TO 165F OR ABOVE FOR HOT HOLDING AT 135F OR ABOVE DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: MIXED GREENS AT 45F IN ICE BATH IN FRONT SERVICE AREA; MIXED GREENS AT 51F IN 1 DOOR PREP (ONLINE)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED FOODS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: REFRIGERATION UNITS AND COUNTERS.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND IMPLEMENT AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED FLOOR DRAIN UNDER 3 COMPARTMENT SINK IS BLOCKED AND UNABLE TO DRAIN. WATER OVERFLOWS INTO SECONDARY FLOW DRAINS IN DISHWASHING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REQUEST SERVICE DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE EMAIL EHS ONCE DRAIN HAS BEEN CLEARED AND CAN ACCOMMODATE WATER DRAINING FROM 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Refuse Storage Area, No Nuisance
violations.observation: OBSERVED BAGS OF THRASH STORED ADJACENT TO THE OUTDOOR DINING AREA NOT SECURED IN RECEPTACLES/BINS TO PREVENT ACCESS TO PESTS OR PREVENT NUISANCE CONDITIONS.
violations.corrective_action: The area designated for refuse, recyclable, and returnables shall not create a public health hazard or nuisance or interfere with the cleaning of adjacent space. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC TRANSFERRED BAGS TO RECEPTACLES/BINS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE WASTE IS PROPERLY DISPOSED IN THE DESIGNATED RECEPTACLES/BINS AT ALL TIMES.. CHIPOTLE MEXICAN GRILL #334 (Inspection Date: 06/15/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: TRAYS IN DISHWASHING MACHINE ON COMPLETION OF WASH CYCLE MEASURED AT 0PPM SANITIZER LEVEL. OBSERVED ACCUMULATION OF SUDS ON DISHES AT END OF THE WASH CYCLE.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO SET UP SANITIZING BASIN OF 3 COMPARTMENT SINK WITH SANITIZER OF APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATION TO COMPLETE RINSE AND SANITIZING PROCESSES.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: FOOD PAN ON STACKED ON RACK WITH ACCUMULATION OF DRIED FOOD.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC TRANSFERRED PAN TO 3 COMPARTMENT TO RE-WASHING.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. OBSERVED THREE-VAT SINK MEET MAXIUM TEMPERATURE OF 108F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PIC UNDERSTANDS THREE VAT SINK MUST MEET 110F; PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP.
